declarations.description:
Draws arrows, boxes, text, numbered steps, blur and redaction over an image, then exports a PNG and the shapes:
the markup step of a bug report, a support ticket or a design review.

Pick a tool from the toolbar and drag on the image (click for text and numbers); Shift keeps lines at 45° steps and
boxes square. `select` moves and resizes shapes by their handles. Colours come from `colors`, and three stroke
widths are offered. Undo and redo are buttons, and Ctrl/⌘+Z and Shift+Ctrl/⌘+Z.

Shapes are plain objects in the image's own pixels (`shapes`, JSON as an attribute), so they stay in place at any
display size; `annotation-change` gives them after every edit. `toBlob()` and `toDataURL()` draw the image at its
natural size with the shapes. Redactions are drawn above every other shape. In the export, a redaction replaces the
pixels and a blur is a coarse pixelation, so
text under either cannot be recovered; use redaction for secrets. An image from another origin needs CORS
(`crossorigin`) to be exported: otherwise the export rejects and `annotator-error` says why.

Every tool works from the keyboard: with a drawing tool chosen, Enter on the image adds a shape in the middle; with
`select`, Tab reaches each shape, the arrow keys nudge it (Shift for 10 px) and Delete removes it. `readonly` shows
the shapes with no toolbar.
declarations.name: ImageAnnotator

cssProperties.description: Behind the image, seen through transparent pixels.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__stage--background-color

cssProperties.description: The selected shape's outline and handles.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__selection--color

cssProperties.description: Text shapes, on screen and in the export.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__text--font-family

cssProperties.description: The digit in a number badge.
cssProperties.name: --c2-image-annotator__number--color

members.name: crossorigin
members.description: Passed to the image; `anonymous` lets an image from another origin with CORS be exported.

members.name: colors
members.description: The colours offered; the first is chosen to start.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the shapes with no toolbar and no editing.

members.name: alt
members.description: The image's accessible description, read before its shapes.

members.name: editOrigin
members.description: The shapes before the text being edited was added or changed: the edit commits against them.

type.text: { kind: 'draw' | 'move' | 'handle'; startX: number; startY: number; origin: AnnotatorShape; handle?: number; moved: boolean } | null

members.name: clearHistory
members.description: Clears the history, so a new image starts with nothing to undo.

members.name: toCanvas
members.description: The image at its natural size with the shapes drawn on it, redactions and blurs flattened into the pixels.

members.name: toBlob
members.description: The annotated image as a `Blob`; `image/png` unless another type is given.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description: The annotated image as a data URL.

members.name: paint
members.description: Draws one shape onto the export canvas, the same geometry as the SVG.

members.name: layered
members.description: The shapes in drawing order: as drawn, with every redaction on top.

members.name: point
members.description: A pointer position in image pixels.

members.name: resized
members.description: The shape after dragging handle `handle` to (`x`, `y`): the two ends of a line, else the four corners.

members.name: step
members.description: Undo or redo from the toolbar; when that empties its stack the button turns off, so focus moves to the image.

members.name: finishText
members.description: Ends the text edit with `value` (the editor's text when left out): one history entry, or none if nothing changed.

events.name: annotator-error
events.description: An export failed, for example on a cross-origin image without CORS.

events.name: annotation-change
events.description: The shapes changed: drawn, moved, resized, edited, deleted, undone or redone.
